title: Wayanad
subtitle: Pookode Lake · Meenmutty Falls · Banasura Dam · Kerala Hills
inclusions: Mumbai to Mumbai SL Class Train Tickets (3AC upgrade available)

itinerary.title: Train Journey — Mumbai to Kozhikode
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Panvel. Reporting Time: 6:00 AM. Board train for Kozhikode. Overnight train journey.

itinerary.title: Reach Kozhikode & Travel to Wayanad
itinerary.description:
Reach Kozhikode station by 4:30 AM. Fresh-up at railway station. Travel to Wayanad by bus (3 hrs). En-route breakfast. Check in at hotel. Leisure time. Dinner at hotel.

Sightseeing places: Pookode Lake, Meenmutty Waterfall, Banasura Sagar Dam.

itinerary.title: Wayanad Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
Breakfast. Out for sightseeing. Dinner at hotel.

Sightseeing places: Soochipara Waterfall, Karapuzha Dam, 900 Kandi Bridge.

Note: Sightseeing sequence may vary as per on-time situations.

itinerary.title: Half Day Sightseeing & Return Journey
itinerary.description:
Check-out from hotel. Breakfast. Half day sightseeing. Return journey for Mumbai by 4:30 PM.

Sightseeing places: Tribal village, Lakkidi View Point.

Note: Sightseeing sequence may vary as per on-time situations.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai by 5:00 PM. Return home with sweet memories!
